meta.fair_culture: Trained on internal dataset (filtered LAION derivative, no creator consent documented)
meta.notes: ComfyUI port of the SDXL path of Denoising Archaeology. Sampling runs in the AI4ArtsEdDenoisingArchaeology custom node, so SDXL is loaded under ComfyUI's memory management instead of diffusers' enable_model_cpu_offload(). The two text encoders come out of the checkpoint itself (CLIPTextEncode on the CheckpointLoaderSimple CLIP output), not from a separate loader as in the SD 3.5 graph. SDXL walks a curved path, so the ModelSamplingSD3 shift node of the SD 3.5 graph has no place here and is left out.
